clue.text: Sombre mood is maliciously suppressed

clue.text: Dodges state taxes after evacuation

clue.text: In mirror, glimpse took in belts and blocks

clue.text: You reportedly learnt processing with numerous examples initially!

indicators.note: processing works the letters of learnt over into a new order

taken as written
